scripts.build: dotnet fable src -o build/client -e .js --run vite build
scripts.start: dotnet fable watch src -s -o build/client -e .js --run vite
scripts.publish: npm run build -- --base=/AureliaWordle/ && npx gh-pages -d dist
scripts.build:bolero: tailwindcss -i public/main.css -o bolero/wwwroot/css/main.css --minify && dotnet publish bolero -c Release -o dist-bolero
scripts.start:bolero: tailwindcss -i public/main.css -o bolero/wwwroot/css/main.css && dotnet run --project bolero
